notes_for_editor: Thin record: one source, the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (map revised March 2016), plus the NHLR Georgia list, which does not name this tower. The entry has no GFC or BLL code. Searches and register pages found nothing on build date, design, staffing, fate, current status or access. The elevation unit is not printed; it is read as feet (209 ft = 63.7 m matches elevation_m). The name is the compiler's label. A search snippet describes 'Henderson Still' as a place in Atkinson County (a genealogy site, not read), so it is not cited and does not show the tower's name origin.
